Bookworm.name: Bookworm
Bookworm.description:
📖 You spent lunch in the library and train rides in a novel.

🏅 You had the highest marks in the year, more or less by accident.
🔎 Digging through sources for an answer comes naturally.

📈 Grants: Academics +5, Investigation +5
Bookworm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character read everything in high school and remembers most of it: facts, references and footnotes come up in conversation. They are good at research and slow to trust a claim without a source.
